result.explanation: Conditional rule: process each batch only after invalidity, version, guard, and capacity checks in that order. A successful batch commits all updates atomically; version changes only when values change. I considered history-based rollback, but repeated old batches show only the current version and values matter.
result.mapping: Target variables are current register values and version. Guards constrain the current snapshot; updates define one candidate snapshot; status and changed derive solely from the ordered checks.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated legal JSON bounds. JavaScript object keys represent register identities, and code-point sorting is implemented explicitly.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){let c=input.config,v=Object.assign({},c.initial),ver=0,cap=c.capacity;let eq=(a,b)=>a===b,keys=o=>Object.keys(o),sort=a=>a.sort((x,y)=>{let A=Array.from(x),B=Array.from(y),n=Math.min(A.length,B.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(A[i]!==B[i])return A[i]<B[i]?-1:1;return A.length-B.length});if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(let z=0;z<input.events.length;z++){let e=input.events[z],s='committed',bad=false,g=e.guards||{},u=e.updates||{};for(let k of keys(g))if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k))bad=true;for(let k of keys(u)){if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(g,k)||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k)||u[k]<0)bad=true}if(bad)s='invalid';else if(e.version!==ver)s='stale';else{for(let k of keys(g))if(v[k]!==g[k])s='conflict';if(s==='committed'){let q=Object.assign({},v);for(let k of keys(u))q[k]=u[k];let sum=0;for(let k of keys(q))sum+=q[k];if(sum>cap)s='capacity';else{let ch=sort(keys(u).filter(k=>q[k]!==v[k]));if(!ch.length)s='unchanged';else{v=q;ver++;}}}}let ch=s==='committed'?sort(keys(u).filter(k=>u[k]!==undefined)):[];if(s!=='committed')ch=[];let o=output[z];if(!o||o.status!==s||o.version!==ver||JSON.stringify(o.values)!==JSON.stringify(v)||JSON.stringify(o.changed)!==JSON.stringify(ch))return false}return true}
result.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state;if(s===null)s={v:Object.assign({},config.initial),n:0};let v=s.v,n=s.n,g=event.guards,u=event.updates,bad=false;for(let k in g)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k))bad=true;for(let k in u)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(g,k)||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k)||u[k]<0)bad=true;let status;if(bad)status='invalid';else if(event.version!==n)status='stale';else{status='committed';for(let k in g)if(v[k]!==g[k]){status='conflict';break}if(status==='committed'){let q=Object.assign({},v);for(let k in u)q[k]=u[k];let sum=0;for(let k in q)sum+=q[k];if(sum>config.capacity)status='capacity';else{let ch=Object.keys(q).filter(k=>q[k]!==v[k]);if(!ch.length)status='unchanged';else{v=q;n++}}}}let changed=[];if(status==='committed'){changed=Object.keys(v).filter(k=>v[k]!==s.v[k]);changed.sort((a,b)=>{let A=Array.from(a),B=Array.from(b),m=Math.min(A.length,B.length);for(let i=0;i<m;i++)if(A[i]!==B[i])return A[i]<B[i]?-1:1;return A.length-B.length})}let out={status:status,version:n,values:Object.assign({},v),changed:changed};return {state:{v:v,n:n},output:out}}
